model: KTRBUu217.456 BACnet room controller - application 2KD001 (2-pipe heating/cooling ceiling with dew point monitor)
applies_to: ALRE KTRBUu217.456 flush-mounted BACnet MS/TP room controller set to application 2KD001: 2-pipe heating/cooling ceiling with dew point monitor.
summary: The KTRBUu217.456 is a flush-mounted 230 V room controller with display and BACnet MS/TP (B-AAC). Each built-in application loads its own object set; this entry is application 2KD001, chilled/heated ceiling, 2-pipe. The BMS sets the operation mode, heating/cooling mode and setpoints, writes window, presence and fire-alarm states, and must keep a heartbeat going to stay in online mode.
notes: Object list from ALRE's published EDE file for application 2KD001; the device object is left out. Application meanings from section 12.3 of the KTRBUu217.456 Handbuch (German).
The EDE file has no access column; access here is inferred. The controller writes many of its own objects cyclically, so the BMS must write at a higher priority (Handbuch, troubleshooting).
Multistate state numbers are taken from the order of the EDE state texts (1 = first text).
Instance numbers follow a pattern: heating objects x1x, cooling objects x2x (setpoints AV 12-15 / 22-25, outputs AO 11 / 21, loops 10 / 20).

integration.summary: Set device instance, MAC address (1-127), baud rate, Max Master and Max Info Frames on the controller. From the BMS, write Operation Mode BMS and (where present) Control-Mode BMS, the setpoints, and the window/presence states, and keep rewriting Heartbeat Input so the controller stays online.

minimum_points.name: Window State
minimum_points.why: Window open from the BMS, 1 = open

minimum_points.name: Heartbeat Input
minimum_points.why: Rewrite seconds before it counts down to 0

integration.enable: Operation Mode BMS (MV 2) selects protection, economy, pre-comfort or comfort; the schedule object can also drive it. Fire Alarm (BV 6) puts the controller into its fire-alarm state.
integration.heartbeat: Heartbeat Input (AV 30): the BMS writes a number of seconds and the controller counts it down once per second. At 0 the controller goes to offline mode (local operation only); the BMS must write a new value before it reaches 0.
integration.remote_sensors: Window State (BV 2) and Presence Detector (BV 3) are written by the BMS from its own window contacts and presence sensors; the controller reads window open from BV 2.
setup: Device instance 0-4194302, MS/TP MAC 1-127, baud rate, Max Master and Max Info Frames are set in the controller's BACnet menu.
Local Config PIN (AV 4) protects the local configuration menu; Maximum Local Offset (AV 5) limits the user's setpoint shift.
Factory settings: device instance 78, baud 115200, MS/TP address 128, which keeps the port off until a 1-127 address is set.
gotchas: Without a regular heartbeat write the controller drops to offline mode.
The controller rewrites many objects itself; command them at a higher priority or the change looks ignored.
